zh: 竖直航线由一个横坐标完全确定，水平航线由一个纵坐标完全确定，不存在其他形式的直线。
分别统计每个横坐标、每个纵坐标出现的次数（重复的点照样计数），最大频次就是一条航线最多能覆盖的点数。
读入 n 个横坐标和 n 个纵坐标，用哈希表或排序求出两组各自的最大频次，取较大者 best；若 best ≥2 输出 best，否则输出 0。
en: A vertical line is fully determined by one x coordinate and a horizontal line by one y coordinate; no other lines are allowed.
Count how many times each x value and each y value occurs (repeated points count again); the highest frequency is the most points one line can cover.
Read the n x coordinates and the n y coordinates, get the highest frequency of each group with a hash map or by sorting, and let best be the larger one; print best if best >= 2, otherwise 0.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Count the occurrences of every x coordinate and every y coordinate separately, take the maximum, and apply the at-least-two-points condition.

## Proof of correctness

A vertical line is completely determined by a fixed x coordinate and a horizontal line by a fixed y coordinate; the two frequency tables therefore enumerate exactly the number of records covered by every possible line.

## Complexity

O(n) time, O(n) space.
